We’re passionate about our products and love what we do. We’d love to introduce ourselves! Our History 1990 Founding of HSM-Menne GmbH This is where it all began: in the basement of his parents’ home in Hövelhof. There, in 1990, Frank Menne founded HSM-Menne GmbH, a company providing hardware and software services, together with his father. The basement, however, did not live up to its name, as the company’s headquarters at the time offered plenty of space for the rapidly growing business. After a few years, the company had six employees. Starting in the mid-90s, projects with major companies such as VW, Audi, Nixdorf, Oracle Germany, and others began to grow. From 2000 onward, the company continued to expand and offered consulting services to clients such as Deutsche Bank and SEB. 2001 Development of the first OctoGate firewall After two years of development, the first OctoGate firewall was completed.
